White Rabbit Gastropub

18 Market Space Frederick Maryland • 240-651-1952

 ~Hours~

Open 7 days a week, 11am-10pm

Brunch: Sat-Sun, 11am-3pm

The White Rabbit is Downtown Frederick's first and only craft beer house & gastropub featuring 42 rotating taps of beer, cider and wine, also fine spirits and craft cocktails. Dine on award-winning Detroit-style pizza and other world-class pub fare, all in the comfort of a speakeasy location with the ambiance of a 7th generation hatter's estate. Bask in the warm glow of our small batch whiskey bar parlor or dine with brother elk in the first level lodge. Follow the White Rabbit down the rabbit hole, and you’ll never look back.
